newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi shares higher in steady trade.
newsitem.headline: Saudi shares higher in steady trade.

text.p: Shares on the Saudi stock market ended the week to Thursday higher in trading dominated by service sector shares, figures from the Riyadh-based Bakheet Financial Advisors (BFA) showed on Saturday.
The index ended the week higher 0.13 percent at 162.04 from 161.83 points a week earlier.
Of the 56 companies traded, 35 rose, 16 fell and five were unchanged.
Services sectors accounted for 59 percent of volume which BFA put at 8.75 million shares worth about 1.2 billion riyals ($330 million).
Real estate firm Makkah Construction and Development Company was the leading player in the week adding 9.6 percent to 228 riyals from 208 riyals last week.
Aseer was also a big gainer, adding 9.3 percent to 82 riyals from 75 the previous week.
Saudi Industrial Export added 9.2 percent to 119 from 109.
